{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# First, check if any revenue has commas or other formatting
print(f"Revenue contains commas: {df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()}")

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (should be 999999.99)
qa_count = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {qa_count}")

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the filtered population
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}")"}
